errors.evidence: The description claims that "noch ungewiss" is a category for both main criteria ("Geschäftsvolumen" and "Beschäftigung"). However, for "Erwartetes Geschäftsvolumen" the category is "ungewiss", while "noch ungewiss" is only used for "Beschäftigungserwartung".
The description does not mention the units of the horizontal axis, which are explicitly stated as "in %".
The bar for "gleichbleibend" for "übrige Betriebe" in the "Erwartetes Geschäftsvolumen" section has a value of approximately 44%, not 60%.
